# Park Kunryul — Backend / DevOps / Server Engineer

This is the public engineering portfolio of Park Kunryul (박건률).
The site documents deployed services, Linux server operations, CI/CD, infrastructure design, and incident troubleshooting.

Primary language: Korean
Canonical site: https://pt.niah.site/
GitHub: https://github.com/niahdev

- Portfolio overview: https://pt.niah.site/

- Troubleshooting case browser: https://pt.niah.site/troubleshooting/
- Incident archive: https://pt.niah.site/incidents/
- Infrastructure lab: https://pt.niah.site/lab/

The Kubernetes record is explicitly marked Investigating. Other incident pages distinguish verified evidence from missing historical data and do not invent operational metrics.
